title: Dialogue contracts
description: DialogueDefinition (06 §17, §18, §33, §37, §43; 04 §5.3 Choice/continuation resolution; 21 §20), owned by dialogue@1.

DialogueDefinition.description: One dialogue node (06 §17; Early R7/R8 D1), keyed in CompiledCartridge.dialogues by DefinitionRefString of kind dialogue, owned by dialogue@1 (a cartridge with one requires it): its key, also the stable action key of its talk (no action's, recipe's, quest's or registered command's: DUPLICATE_DEFINITION) and the beat of the choice it opens; npc, the speaker, whose talk the actor's ActionSet offers while the speaker is in the actor's room, and which is one of the npc roles (a speaker may have several dialogues: a talk to it opens the first, in key order, whose policy holds, and is invalid_state when none does); policy, the talk's availability; prompt, the text key of the pending choice's prompt; roles, the participants talk binds to EntityIds in the durable choice (06 §33, §43: bound once, never re-resolved by name), each an npc that must be in the actor's room or an item the actor's body must hold when a choice is made (else not_present or not_owned), never named actor (the actor is always a participant: DUPLICATE_DEFINITION); quest, the quest a choice resolves through quest@1's resolution, with the choice_id as its outcome (absent in a dialogue with an accept choice, so accepting never resolves: OUTCOME_MISMATCH); and choices, at least one (a loader check: the subset has no minProperties), each with its label, its narration line (committed with the actor's body and every role pinned), its fact.assign consequences and an optional hand_over of an item role to an npc role. Choices list in key order.

DialogueRole.description: A dialogue role's participant, as action.schema.json NarrationParticipant's npc or item branch (the actor is implicit): an NPC or item of this cartridge (else UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE).

DialogueChoice.description: One option of a dialogue (06 §17, §43): label and narration its text keys; sequence, its fact.assign consequences in order (a declared fact of the cartridge at the one scope it allows, a value of its type, as a recipe's: fact@1 emits fact_changed when the value changes); hand_over, the item role the actor's body gives to the npc role (an item_acquired with that NPC as holder, as give); accept, a quest of this cartridge the choice activates as quest@1's activation does (quest.activate at player scope and quest_activated; the choose is invalid_state when accept_quest would be: the actor already has an instance of it, or its offer, if declared, has a policy that fails), never with a hand_over (activation and acquisition in one decision conflict: OUTCOME_MISMATCH). The choose that selects it applies all of them, resolves the dialogue's quest or activates the accepted one, and resolves the choice in one decision; its outcome is the choice_id. API1.7 receive {item, from} transfers the selected bound NPC-held item into the actor body, only while resolving a quest and never with accept/hand_over. API1.7 fact.adjust applies a safe integer amount to a declared bounded integer fact using checked addition then authored bounds, lowered to fact.assign.
